title: AttemptLogEntry kind vocabulary is a raw string wire contract duplicated across server and client with no shared definition
evidence:
let kind = case cycle_index {
      0 -> "invitation_sent"
      1 -> "co_nudge"
      _ -> "reminder_sent"
    }

client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1389:
  kind == "invitation_sent" || kind == "co_nudge" || kind == "reminder_sent"
detail: The eight kind strings are hardcoded in the server builder and in three client match/filter sites; shared documents the vocabulary only as prose in a doc comment. A rename drifts silently — the client's raw-kind fallback degrades labels instead of failing.
recommended_fix: Define the kind constants in shared/reference_call.gleam and reference them from the builder and client matches, or pin a cross-package kind-set test.
